issues.description: Flag precedence documentation contradicts actual implementation behavior
issues.current_content:
!!! warning "Flag precedence: -x overrides -w"
    When both flags are specified, `-x` (line-regexp) takes precedence over `-w` (word-regexp). The last flag wins:
    ```bash
    rg -w -x "test"   # Uses -x (line matching)
    rg -x -w "test"   # Uses -w (word matching)
    ```
issues.should_be: The warning states -x overrides -w, but the implementation shows -w overrides -x. The actual behavior is: last flag wins, and -w overrides -x (not the other way around).
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the warning to correctly state: "Flag precedence: -w overrides -x" and fix the description to match the implementation. According to crates/core/flags/defs.rs:7541, -w overrides -x, not vice versa.
issues.source_reference: crates/core/flags/defs.rs:7541 (doc_long for WordRegexp flag states 'This overrides the \flag{line-regexp} flag.')
